title: TMC supporters protest in Kolkata following alleged attack on Abhishek Banerjee's home
seoTitle: Kolkata TMC protest after home attack

tea.why: TMC members protested after an alleged attack on the residence and office of party leader Abhishek Banerjee in the early hours of the morning.
tea.want: The protesters demanded action against those they accused of attacking the residence and disrupting local Kali Puja preparations.
tea.changed: Nov 7: Mamata Banerjee joined the protest and accused the BJP of orchestrating the attack and disrupting local festivities.

summary: On November 7, 2026, Trinamool Congress (TMC) supporters held a protest outside the Kalighat residence of party national general secretary Abhishek Banerjee in Kolkata. The demonstration followed an alleged attack on his home and office by individuals described by the party as BJP supporters around 2:00 AM. Clashes reportedly occurred between TMC workers and BJP supporters, resulting in at least eight injuries, three of which were described as serious. TMC chief Mamata Banerjee joined the protest later that morning, condemning the incident as hooliganism and alleging that local Kali Puja and Diwali preparations were being intentionally disrupted. Police deployed a large contingent to the area and detained several individuals in connection with the overnight clashes. Mamata Banerjee stated she had written to the Lok Sabha Speaker regarding the situation.
response: Police deployed a large contingent to the area to manage the situation and detained several individuals in connection with the clashes, according to reports.

arrests.text: Police detained several people in connection with the clashes.

injuries.text: At least eight people were reported injured, three of them seriously.

updates.text: Clashes occurred between TMC and BJP supporters between 2:00 AM and 3:30 AM.
Mamata Banerjee joined the protest outside the Kalighat residence.
